Each piece is meticulously hand-poured, imbued with subtle imperfections that mimic the uniqueness found in nature such as air bubbles and color variations, making each piece truly special.

The process involves hand-mixing and coloring each piece before it's poured and carefully sealed, resulting in a distinctive look that ensures no two pieces are alike.

Care Instructions:

To maintain their quality, refrain from immersing the dishes in water or exposing them to prolonged moisture. A gentle wipe with a damp cloth followed by drying is recommended.

Despite being sealed and water-resistant, these products can still absorb liquids and waxes, which might lead to marks or stains.

For optimal longevity and appearance, it's advisable to keep these products indoors, as exposure to outdoor elements can deteriorate them and cause imperfections.

Kindly refrain from using these dishes as food containers, and avoid subjecting them to dishwashers or microwaves.

For best results, do not burn for less than 1 hour or more than 3 hours at a time.

The fragrance you choose may affect the color of the finished look, such as caramel vanilla, Ambered sandalwood, Japanese honeysuckle which give a slight yellow tinge finish.

It is recommended to cure the candle and burn the candle in a small, enclosed space to experience the best scent.

Care instruction:

Please avoid submerging them in water or getting them wet for long period of time. Simply clean with a damp cloth and let it dry.

All our products are sealed and water resistance, however they can still absorb liquids and waxes causing marks and stains.

Please keep these products indoors as the outdoor elements can shorten their lifespan and cause blemish.

Not suitable as a food dish or in the dishwasher or microwave.

Care Instructions:

To maintain their quality, refrain from immersing the dishes in water or exposing them to prolonged moisture. A gentle wipe with a damp cloth followed by drying is recommended.

Despite being sealed and water-resistant, these products can still absorb liquids and waxes, which might lead to marks or stains.

For optimal longevity and appearance, it's advisable to keep these products indoors, as exposure to outdoor elements can deteriorate them and cause imperfections.

Kindly refrain from using these dishes as food containers, and avoid subjecting them to dishwashers or microwaves.

For best results, do not burn for less than 1 hour or more than 3 hours at a time.

The fragrance you choose may affect the color of the finished look, such as caramel vanilla, Ambered sandalwood, Japanese honeysuckle which give a slight yellow tinge finish.

It is recommended to cure the candle and burn the candle in a small, enclosed space to experience the best scent.

Our candles are handcrafted in Perth ,Western Australia , using all-natural soy wax, a 100% cotton wick, and eco-friendly, sustainable materials. They are also phthalate-free and paraffin-free.

Colors may vary slightly due to the use of natural soy wax in all our handmade candles, which may also have minor imperfections.

To preserve their quality, please display the candles away from direct sunlight and in a cool space.

Please note that 'frosting' may occur, but it's a natural effect of soy wax and does not affect the candle's performance. To avoid wax contact with surfaces, we recommend placing the candle on a dish or plate. Since each candle is entirely handmade, minor imperfections and slight color variations are inherent. For irregularly shaped candles, we cannot guarantee full burning.

Warning:

• Store in a dry cool room

• Never leave burning candles unattended

• Extinguish candles before leaving the room

•Refer to the candles care page for attitonal guidance.
